# Story Structure semantic fixtures

These fixtures validate narrative relationships, never target aggregate counts.
the benchmark manuscript cases stress temporal framing; the synthetic cases prevent that
manuscript from becoming the engine's structural template.

Current Stage 1 coverage:

- several observations supporting one awakening/discovery occurrence;
- independent actions remaining separate even when actor and location match;
- incidental description and incidental temporal references remaining atomic;
- persistent state changes becoming significant;
- quiet character-driven occurrences confirmed by an author;
- irrelevant-noise decisions and changed-dependency conflicts.

Reserved fixture forms for gated later stages:

- interrogation frame → Sunday flashback → resumed frame → Monday flashback;
- linear time and location continuity;
- alternating independent viewpoints (`A/B/A/A/B`);
- quiet character-driven and slice-of-life continuity;
- parallel causal stories whose people and locations never meet;
- physical convergence followed by separation;
- communication, reference, memory, theme, and distant causal influence;
- documentary and epistolary passages;
- simulations, dreams, memories, and intentionally ambiguous chronology;
- incomplete manuscripts with unresolved thread candidates.

Each later stage must add source passages and expected relationship reasons for
its reserved forms before that stage's implementation begins.
